## What changed

- `Next Implementation Session` → `What Is Left (gated)` — six gated checkboxes, each pointing at a dated MG @DO/@WAITING row in Uprava `GTD_NEXT_ACTIONS.md`.
- Nothing else touched; all `done` rows stay as the shipped record.

| AR5 reproducibility | active ongoing | standing practice in effect (H5221 generative acceptance test, PR #226) | no discrete deliverable |
| RH1, RH2, RH4, RH5, RH6, SC2–SC6, AR2, AR4, PR2, PR3, PR5 | done | in-repo artifacts (`RH1_LICENSE_ROLLOUT_LOG.md`, `MAINTAINER_CONTINUITY_PACKET.md`, `REVIEWER_REPRODUCIBILITY.md`, SEO config…); RH4 via closed H1542; RH5 template via closed H1496 | shipped |
